title: ESTÁGIO EM DESIGN DE PRODUTO
description:
Empresa está contratando ESTÁGIO EM DESIGN DE PRODUTO em florianópolis. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Vaga presencial em Florianópolis | 30h semanais  Porque se juntar a nós  A Dynamox é uma empresa de alta tecnologia que desenvolve soluções inteligentes de monitoramento de vibração, temperatura, corrente e tensão, ajudando equipes de manutenção e confiabilidade a tornarem a indústria mais segura, eficiente e sustentável.  Hoje, somos a única empresa mundial na área de manutenção com as certificações internacionais ISO 27001, 27701, 27017 e 27018, além da ISO 9001.  Além de processos bem estruturados, acreditamos em pessoas. Aqui, você encontra um ambiente organizado, colaborativo e orientado à melhoria contínua, onde o aprendizado é incentivado e excelência faz parte do dia a dia. Valorizamos quem busca evoluir, inovar e fazer a diferença.  Sobre a equipe na qual você irá atuar  A equipe de Product Design zela pela melhor experiência dos usuários nos pontos de contato com os produtos da Dynamox. Somos uma equipe facilitadora e criativa - formada por Product Designers, Visual Designers e 3D Artists - responsável por pesquisar, analisar, projetar experiências e apresentações dos produtos da Dynamox. Acreditamos que a colaboração é um artefato extremamente importante no nosso dia a dia e por isso atuamos em conjunto com Product Managers, Analistas de Dados, Desenvolvedores, Engenheiros, Analistas de Suporte e profissionais do Marketing.  Principais responsabilidades do cargo   Apoiar na elaboração fluxos de usuários, wireframes, protótipos e componentes visando aprimorar a experiência do cliente;  Apoiar na realização pesquisas quantitativas e/ou qualitativas para identificar oportunidades e problemas na experiência de uso dos produtos;  Apoiar na elaboração de documentações e apresentações dos produtos;  Apoiar na elaboração de vídeos e animações para os produtos;  Apoiar na elaboração e evolução do design system;  Compartilhar conhecimento e colaborar no desenvolvimento do time e dos colegas;  Contribuir e disseminar práticas de segurança de informação, zelando pela confidencialidade, integridade, disponibilidade e privacidade das informações e dados.    Formação   Ensino superior em andamento em Design Gráfico, Design de Produto, Engenharia, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas;  Cursos livres da área de design e experiência do usuário.    Benefícios   Vale transporte sem desconto em folha;  Vale alimentação/refeição flexível sem desconto em folha;  Convênio com Farmasesi e OdontoSesi;  Convênio GoGood - Plataforma de bem-estar;  Convênio EBAC - Escola Britânica de Artes Criativas e Tecnologias;  Atendimento com fisioterapeuta/osteopata na empresa;  Sala de descompressão com puffs, jogos e videogames;  Frutas e café à vontade;  No dress code;  A vista de nosso escritório é incrível! Empresa situada no parque tecnológico de Florianópolis.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Instrutor de Formação Profissional - Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Empresa está contratando Instrutor de Formação Profissional - Segurança do Trabalho em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Descrição  O SENAI – SP está em busca de profissionais para formação de Banco de Talentos  para o Estado de São Paulo. Se você é da área de Segurança do Trabalho  e tem habilidade para compartilhar o seu conhecimento, inscreva-se e venha transformar o futuro da educação e da indústria com a gente!  O que o INSTRUTOR DE FORMAÇÃO PROFISSIONAL  do SENAI SP  irá fazer:  Planejar e preparar instruções e atividades dos cursos de formação e habilitação profissional, abordando conhecimentos tecnológicos e execução de práticas operacionais em equipamentos e instrumentos de tecnologia avançada. Preparar os ambientes de ensino e materiais a serem utilizados no desenvolvimento do curso. Aplicar instrumentos de avaliação na verificação do aproveitamento e do grau de desempenho no processo de ensino aprendizagem. Executar serviços e instruir equipes em assessorias empresariais.  O Instrutor de Segurança do Trabalho poderá atuar nas seguintes áreas:   Assessoria a Empresas e Execução de Programas de Treinamento   Segurança do Trabalho - Ergonomia   Instruções e Práticas de Primeiros Socorros   Saúde Ocupacional   Segurança do Trabalho   Trabalho em Altura, Espaço Confinado e na Construção Civil   Segurança na Operação de Caldeiras     Local de Trabalho: Unidade SENAI SP – Acesse aqui e confira as cidades disponíveis.   A modalidade de contratação e Carga horária será definida no momento da admissão, de acordo com a necessidade do SENAI.   Requisitos  O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ NO DIA A DIA – CONFORME A ÁREA DE ATUAÇÃO:  ·   Assessoria a Empresas e Execução de Programas de Treinamento  Nível II: Assessoria para implantação dos programas PGR, PCMSO, CIPA, eSocial, eSESMT e PPP online; análise investigativa de acidentes e identificação de causas; preenchimento de formulários e registros de acidentes com e sem afastamento; definição e aplicação de medidas de controle administrativas, coletivas e individuais; higiene ocupacional; levantamento e análise estatística de acidentes; elaboração de planos de ação para adequação às normas de saúde e segurança; definição de dispositivos de segurança para equipamentos e instalações; elaboração de programas de inspeção em equipamentos de combate a incêndio e obtenção de laudos técnicos; elaboração de relatórios de reparo, renovação e medidas de segurança; assessoria para implantação de Normas Regulamentadoras; orientação aos funcionários por meio de palestras e treinamentos; organização de reuniões de segurança, apresentação de dados e análise de medidas propostas; utilização de Windows, Word, Excel e softwares específicos; comunicação oral e escrita; organização e controle; relacionamento interpessoal; trabalho em equipe; proatividade.  ·   Segurança do Trabalho – Ergonomia  Conceitos de ergonomia; estrutura da coluna vertebral; patologias relacionadas à postura; orientações posturais no trabalho e no ambiente doméstico; NR 17 e demais normas aplicáveis; análise ergonômica do trabalho (AET); prevenção de lesões; métodos de coleta de dados em ergonomia; biomecânica do corpo humano; ergonomia cognitiva; informática aplicada (Windows, Word, Excel e softwares específicos); trabalho em equipe.  ·   Instruções e Práticas de Primeiros Socorros  Nível II: Definição de primeiros socorros; leis e normas aplicáveis; itens e uso do kit de primeiros socorros; suporte básico de vida para leigos; parada cardiorrespiratória; compressões cardíacas; utilização do desfibrilador externo automático; conduta diante de obstrução de vias aéreas por corpo estranho (OVACE); procedimentos em casos de AVC; conduta em crise convulsiva; manejo de hemorragias; imobilizações; feridas e curativos; uso de Windows, Word, Excel e softwares específicos; trabalho em equipe.  ·   Saúde Ocupacional  Avaliação de riscos ambientais e do processo de trabalho; planejamento das ações de saúde e segurança; ações educativas; elaboração de planos de ação; normas aplicáveis (NR 7, NR 17, NR 32 e correlatas); investigação de doenças ocupacionais; promoção da saúde no trabalho; biossegurança; saúde mental no ambiente laboral; noções de primeiros socorros; orientação sobre práticas saudáveis e preventivas; efeitos da exposição a agentes ambientais; monitoramento da saúde do trabalhador; ergonomia; projetos de saúde e segurança; informática aplicada (Windows, Word, Excel e softwares da área); trabalho em equipe.  ·   Segurança do Trabalho  Avaliação dos riscos ambientais e dos processos de trabalho; planejamento das ações de saúde e segurança; inspeções e auditorias; treinamentos e capacitações; legislação aplicável (CLT, NRs, ABNT); investigação de acidentes; elaboração de programas de saúde e segurança; proteção contra incêndio; medidas de controle administrativas, coletivas e individuais; gerenciamento de EPIs; ações educativas em saúde e segurança; uso de equipamentos de medição em higiene ocupacional; atuação em CIPA; documentação técnica; gestão ambiental; projetos de SST; cultura de segurança (comunicação e conscientização); uso de Windows, Word, Excel e softwares específicos; proatividade; trabalho em equipe.  ·   Trabalho em Altura, Espaço Confinado e na Construção Civil  Orientação sobre o uso de máquinas, ferramentas, instrumentos e aparelhos; preparação da oficina de aprendizagem e organização de materiais e equipamentos; execução de serviços de apoio técnico; apresentações em empresas; orientação em cursos e práticas operacionais; condução de treinamentos para Aprendizagem Industrial e FIC; execução de pesquisas, avaliações e relatórios técnicos; execução e orientação de serviços técnicos tecnológicos; capacitação de profissionais de STT na construção civil; aplicação de checklists conforme NR 18 e normas relacionadas; apoio técnico em eventos tecnológicos; realização de palestras e treinamentos no canteiro de obras; registros de frequência e aproveitamento; apoio em provas e projetos; manutenção de máquinas e equipamentos educacionais; execução de atividades de projeto e produção conforme cronograma; controle e destinação de resíduos; organização de reuniões de segurança; domínio de Windows, Word, Excel e softwares da área; comunicação oral e escrita; organização e controle; relacionamento interpessoal; trabalho em equipe; proatividade.  ·   Segurança na Operação de Caldeiras  Grandezas físicas e unidades (pressão, calor e temperatura); categorias, tipos, partes e utilizações de caldeiras; sistemas, instrumentos e dispositivos de segurança; operação de caldeiras (partida, parada, controle e regulagem); análise de falhas e providências; inspeções e vistoria; operação de sistemas com múltiplas caldeiras; procedimentos de emergência; tratamento de água e manutenção; prevenção de explosões e riscos; legislação e normalização (incluindo NR 13); equipamentos do processo industrial (trocadores de calor, tubulações, válvulas, bombas, compressores, torres, tanques e reatores); operação de unidades industriais e descarte adequado de produtos químicos; avaliação e controle de riscos do processo; classificação e categorias de vasos de pressão; elaboração e aprovação de projetos de alteração e reparo; inspeção de segurança e emissão de relatórios; gestão da qualidade (ISO 9000 e ISO 14000); uso de EPIs e EPCs; comunicação oral e escrita; organização e controle; relacionamento interpessoal; trabalho em equipe; uso de Windows, Word, Excel e softwares específicos; proatividade.  ATENÇÃO! É IMPORTANTE VOCÊ SABER   O contato com os candidatos inscritos se dará somente no surgimento de vaga, pois trata-se de BANCO DE TALENTOS.  A inscrição no Banco de Talentos visa a formação de um cadastro reserva para todo o Estado de São Paulo. Diferente dos demais processos seletivos, o objetivo principal do banco é reunir pessoas qualificadas para serem consideradas em futuras oportunidades.  Ao se cadastrar, é importante entender que esta é uma possibilidade para vagas que podem surgir a curto, médio ou longo prazo, por isso não temos previsão de quando haverá convocação.  A participação nas etapas do processo seletivo (como entrevistas, avaliações ou aulas-teste) poderá ocorrer de forma presencial ou online.  Caso alguma etapa seja realizada online, o acesso à internet e os equipamentos necessários são de responsabilidade da pessoa candidata. Relembramos também que eventuais falhas de conexão, de equipamentos ou a não visualização do e-mail de agendamento poderão impedir a realização e não haverá a possibilidade de reagendamento.  Toda comunicação será realizada exclusivamente por e-mail, por isso pedimos que você mantenha seus dados atualizados e verifique sua caixa de entrada, inclusive spam.  É permitida apenas uma inscrição por candidato(a). Se identificada, a qualquer momento, duplicidade de inscrição, caberá a exclusão do processo seletivo.  As datas das etapas podem ser agendadas com até 24h de antecedência.  Todos os inscritos no processo seletivo receberão o feedback positivo ou negativo, durante ou após o término do processo seletivo.  Caso haja alguma intercorrência, falha, necessidade de alteração nos dados de contato/currículo ou não recebimento da confirmação por e-mail no momento da inscrição, aconselhamos que o suporte da plataforma seja acionado.  Semestralmente, os candidatos inscritos poderão ser convidados a responder novo formulário de triagem para atualização das informações.    Diversidade & Inclusão  Acreditamos que equipes diversas entregam resultados inovadores, possuem maior representatividade e maior impacto social. Por isso, convidamos profissionais de diferentes trajetórias, habilidades e perspectivas para enriquecerem o nosso ambiente de trabalho com suas experiências únicas.  Quer saber mais?  Acesse aqui as informações gerais.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Lead Video Editor
description:
Nova oportunidade para Lead Video Editor em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Transform raw footage into content that helps real estate agents win in their local markets  About Knwn Local  We're a creative agency on a mission: scale from 55 to 200+ YouTube channels while helping real estate agents become the most trusted voices in their markets. We build long-form video strategies that create real authority and drive actual business results.  The proof is in our growth:   Scaling fast from 55 to 200+ channels  Building systematic production operations that work at scale  Helping agents win deals through strategic content, not viral gimmicks    We believe in extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and beyond excellence. If that resonates, you'll thrive here.  We're hiring a Lead Editor to deliver high-quality edits consistently and help us maintain our quality standards across the team as we scale.   As a Lead Editor at Knwn Local, you'll build and develop a team of video editors  who transform raw real estate content into high-impact YouTube videos that help agents dominate their local markets. This is a player-coach leadership role  where you'll spend 70-90% of your time managing, mentoring, and building systems, and 10-30% hands-on editing complex projects.  You’ll own editing quality standards, team development, and operational excellence  within your pod, partnering closely with Pod Managers, YouTube Managers, and Strategists to deliver retention-driven content at scale. Your success is measured not by how many videos you edit, but by how well your team performs, grows, and retains talent.  This role is perfect for someone who loves developing editors as much as editing itself  and gets energized by building systems, coaching talent, and multiplying their impact through others. If you want to stay purely hands‑on without management responsibilities, or purely hands‑off without getting in the weeds of editing, this isn't the right fit.  Team Leadership & Development (50% of role)   Manage and develop 25-50 video editors, conducting weekly 1-on-1s focused on skill progression and performance (with the support of multiple Senior Editors & YouTube Managers)  Lead weekly team edit reviews with constructive feedback and best practice sharing  Lead monthly team trainings for the editing team culture & growth  Build comprehensive onboarding programs and training materials for new editor hires  Create career development pathways with clear promotion criteria for your team  Conduct performance reviews and manage accountability through the Clarify Instrument Coach Decide framework  Participate in hiring (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring recommendations)  Build 2-5+ year relationships with editors through proactive retention and engagement strategies  Implement skip-level check-ins to assess team health and identify early warning signs    Quality Standards & Systems (20-30% of role)   Own and evolve editing quality standards, style guides, and templates across your team  Establish QA processes that maintain >85% First-Approval Rate across all editors  Serve as final quality review and approval for complex or high-stakes edits before client delivery  Lead A/B testing strategy and retention analysis, translating data into actionable editing improvements  Create efficiency systems (templates, motion graphics libraries, workflow optimizations)  Build performance dashboards tracking team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention performance)  Drive continuous improvement through weekly "edit of the week" reviews and retrospectives    Strategic Collaboration (10-15% of role)   Partner with Pod Manager and YouTube Managers on content strategy and creative direction  Participate in Monthly Client Strategy Calls to present editing approach and performance insights  Collaborate cross-functionally with scriptwriters and designers to align on creative vision  Communicate proactively with leadership on team capacity, blockers, and resource needs  Contribute to quarterly planning and annual strategy with editing function perspective  Handle client escalations and quality issues with transparency and solutions-focused approach    Player-Coach Editing (10-20% of role)   Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per month for VIP clients or training demonstrations  Model excellence by staying hands‑on with the craft and maintaining YouTube editing fluency  Stay current on YouTube editing trends, competitor content, and platform algorithm changes  Experiment with new techniques and tools, sharing learnings and innovations with the team  Maintain organized project files and asset management as an example for the team    Requirements  We're looking for someone who combines exceptional editing craft with proven leadership ability. You should be passionate about developing talent and building systems that multiply impact across a team, not just delivering great edits yourself.  Leadership & Management Experience   5-7+ years of professional video editing experience  with 2+ years managing or leading editors   Proven track record developing and scaling editing teams of 4+ people  Experience hiring editors (screening portfolios, conducting interviews, making hiring decisions)  Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality  History of conducting performance reviews and managing accountability (including difficult conversations)  Experience building onboarding programs, training materials, and documented workflows  Comfortable with the full people management cycle: hiring, coaching, performance management, and when necessary, firing    Technical Mastery (You Can Teach Others)   Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro  – you can troubleshoot complex technical issues and teach advanced techniques  Strong proficiency in After Effects  for motion graphics and visual effects  Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve, Blender, or other tools (or quick learner)  Deep understanding of YouTube retention, pacing, storytelling, and algorithm optimization  Ability to QA others' work and identify issues across editing style, technical execution, and brand consistency  Portfolio showcasing both your own work AND examples of team development     Systems & Process Thinking   Experience building scalable editing workflows, style guides, and template systems  Understanding of capacity planning and resource allocation for editing teams  Ability to create performance dashboards and track team metrics (approval rates, turnaround times, retention)  Skilled at documentation – SOPs, training materials, and knowledge management  Process optimization mindset – constantly looking for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality  Experience with project management tools (Asana, Notion, Frame.io) and team collaboration systems    Strategic & Business Acumen   Ability to translate business objectives into editing strategy and creative direction  Comfortable presenting to clients and defending creative decisions with data and performance insights  Understanding of editing team economics (capacity planning, turnaround times, quality vs. speed tradeoffs)  Experience partnering cross-functionally with strategists, writers, designers, and YouTube managers  Can navigate ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information  Thinks beyond individual edits to how editing impacts channel growth and client business results    Communication & Influence   Exceptional written and verbal communication  for feedback, presentations, and team documentation  Ability to give direct, constructive feedback that motivates rather than demoralizes  Skilled at managing up (keeping leadership informed), across (collaborating with peers), and down (developing direct reports)  Proactive communication style – you flag capacity issues, quality concerns, and team challenges before they become crises  Comfortable with difficult conversations (performance issues, client escalations, conflict resolution)  Can translate technical editing concepts into language that non-editors understand    Work Style & Mindset   Player-coach mentality  – willing to stay hands-on with editing (10-20% of time) while primarily focusing on team leadership  Excellent organizational skills managing both your own work and your team's project pipeline  Ability to balance competing priorities: team development, quality standards, client deadlines, and strategic initiatives  Comfortable context-switching between hands-on editing, team coaching, client calls, and strategic planning  Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments where processes are constantly evolving  Gets energized by developing talent and seeing team members succeed  Extreme Ownership  – Takes full accountability for team results; models this for direct reports  Beyond Excellence  – Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to consistently exceed them  Proactive Curiosity  – Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of issues  Mission Focus  – Obsesses about client success and team development, not personal recognition    Results You'll Drive  Team Performance   Your editing team consistently maintains >85% First-Approval Rate across all editors  Editor retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression  New editors productive at 80% capacity within 60 days through your training systems  100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter  Team operates at 80-90% capacity utilization – productive output without burnout    Quality & Systems   Zero client escalations due to editing quality issues or missed deadlines from your team  95%+ on-time delivery rate across your entire team's project portfolio  Editing workflows, templates, and style guides documented and adopted agency-wide  Average video retention improves 5-10% year-over-year through data-driven editing strategies    Strategic Impact   Editing function viewed as strategic partner by Pod Managers and leadership  Successfully contribute to client strategy with editing insights that drive performance  Your team supports clients publishing 4+ videos per month consistently  Client satisfaction scores remain >4.5/5 for editing quality and communication  At least 1-2 editors promoted or advancement-ready annually due to your mentorship  Edit 2-4 high-complexity videos per week as benchmarks and training examples  Your edits consistently achieve 8-10% average retention (above platform benchmarks)  Model extreme ownership, excellence, and proactive curiosity through your work    COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:  Salary:  $36,000 - $60,000 USD annually (based on experience and team size managed)  What We Offer:   Fully Remote  Flexible Time Off policy (we trust you to manage your time and energy)  Access to industry-leading tools, plugins, and AI-assisted editing software  Opportunities to earn Monthly wellness allowance, Home office stipend, Professional development budget &/or Health Insurance Reimbursement (after 60-90 day trial period)  Clear career progression with transparent promotion criteria    REAL TALK:  This is an early-stage startup scaling rapidly. You'll face challenges – processes break, priorities shift, and things get messy. We need people who are resilient, resourceful, and committed long-term.  But if you want to:   Build a world-class editing team  and multiply your impact 10x  Develop editors and watch them grow beyond their potential  Help America's top real estate leaders dominate their local markets  Build something meaningful  from 55 to 200+ channels    This is the place.  This role is player-coach (10-25% hands-on editing, 75%+ leadership).  If you want to focus purely on editing without managing people, this isn't the right fit.  Location  Remote-first  Our Core Values   Extreme Ownership  – Take responsibility for your work and outcomes. No excuses, just solutions.  Beyond Excellence  – Care about the details. Deliver work that exceeds expectations.  Proactive Curiosity  – Don't wait to be told. Ask questions, identify problems, suggest solutions.  Mission Focus  – Remember: your edits help real estate agents build their businesses. That matters.    We primarily look at those who apply above.  Pay $36K - $60K+ USD a year (depending on experience)   #J-18808-Ljbffr

At Teleflex, we are empowering the future of healthcare. For more information, please visit teleflex.com .  Interventional  The Interventional business unit at Teleflex offers innovative medical devices that are used to diagnose and treat coronary and peripheral vascular diseases. We place a strategic emphasis on complex coronary and peripheral interventions, vascular access, bone access, specialty biologic treatments and cardiac assist. Our current Interventional products include a broad range of clinically relevant solutions, such as our GuideLiner™ and Turnpike™ Catheters, Ringer™ Perfusion Balloon Catheter, AC3 Optimus™ and AC3 Range™ Intra‑Aortic Balloon Pumps and the OnControl™ Powered Bone Access System. Teleflex’s product portfolio now also includes Passeo™-18 Lux™ Peripheral Drug‑Coated Balloon Catheter, Pantera™ Lux™ Drug‑Coated Balloon Catheter, Orsiro™ Mission™ Drug‑Eluting Stent, the PK Papyrus™ Covered Coronary Stent, and more. With a strong R&D footprint and pipeline, our fast‑growing Interventional business unit is poised to continue the development of new technologies to serve critically ill patients for years to come. Join a dynamic, growing team that offers healthcare providers an array of medical technology solutions that make a difference in patients’ lives.  Position Summary  The Medical Education Manager serves as a subject matter expert in Interventional Cardiology, advancing patient care through education and collaboration. This role partners with cross‑functional teams to deliver impactful training, provide guidance on product safety and efficacy, and support clinical adoption through evidence‑based programs. By leading faculty engagement and developing procedural education initiatives, the position ensures clinicians have the confidence and knowledge to utilize Teleflex products safely and effectively, driving improved outcomes and greater product acceptance.  Principal Responsibilities   Partner with commercial teams to plan, execute, and review clinical education initiatives, professional training, speaker programs, and related activities that support healthcare professionals in adopting advanced technologies and procedures for coronary and peripheral vascular interventions.  Design and deliver procedural education programs that promote best practices for the safe and effective use of Teleflex products.  Oversee peer‑to‑peer programs, including development and management of presentations by external healthcare providers for the Interventional product portfolio.  Manage healthcare professional engagement systems, ensuring compliance with transparency standards, international guidelines, and local regulations throughout contracting, execution, and payment processes.  Prepare and deliver educational and scientific presentations for advisory boards, institutional meetings, and non‑promotional symposia.  Provide accurate medical and scientific information, including clinical data on marketed and pipeline products, to internal teams and healthcare professionals.  Offer feedback on product training development and collaborate with sales training to enhance new hire education materials.  Maintain compliance with regulatory requirements, industry codes of ethics, and company policies governing interactions with healthcare professionals as well as Teleflex’s Code of Conduct.  Respond to unsolicited off‑label inquiries in accordance with CMA policy.    Education / Experience Requirements   Healthcare professional (HCP) (physician or nurse) specialist with demonstrated experience in Interventional Cardiology and/or peripheral vascular intervention.  Training and/or experience in healthcare services management or professional education.  Minimum of 5 years of clinical experience required; 2 or more years in a management role preferred.  Experience in the Medical Device Industry preferred.  Fluency in English and Spanish is required.    Specialized Skills / Other Requirements   Recognized and respected within the specialty community, active member of relevant professional societies.  Strong reputation among peers with demonstrated credibility and expertise.  Deep understanding of market needs and current solutions; capable of developing strategic plans to address unmet patient requirements.  Proven ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.  Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).  Skilled in problem‑solving, data analysis, and drawing sound conclusions.  Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to deliver clear, professional presentations.  Adaptable to change and comfortable working in a fluid environment.  Ability to interpret clinical evidence and integrate findings into product and procedural education.  Strong collaboration skills, building effective relationships internally within a matrixed organization and externally with diverse partners.  Experienced in navigating regulatory requirements while achieving business objectives.  Effective negotiation and consensus‑building skills; able to influence and align stakeholders.  Willingness to travel up to 60% regionally, including overnight trips.    Culture   Customer Experience – Representing Teleflex in a customer‑facing position is a tremendous responsibility and opportunity. All CMA colleagues are expected to perform with the highest levels of professionalism, service, and ethics in order to strengthen the Teleflex brand and relationship with our customers.  Continuous Improvement – Demonstrates initiative and critical thinking to identify and prioritize process and performance gaps. Develops solutions to deliver improved results. Exemplifies continuous improvement of thought processes and focus.  Culture and Values – Exemplifies Teleflex values and ensures a fair, open, and productive climate that is engaging, ethical, and legally compliant. Strives to work effectively across boundaries in a complex matrix environment. Lead and participate in the process of promotional and other materials, working internally and cross‑functionally to ensure materials are processed completely, based on accurate interpretation of clinical practice and data.    At Teleflex, we follow a comprehensive hiring process. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from agency recruiters or third‑party firms. We do not make unsolicited job offers. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. title: Responsable desarrollo negocio (sector público)
description:
Confira a vaga para Responsable desarrollo negocio (sector público) em registro. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Somos una compañía global, líder en el desarrollo de infraestructuras regenerativas que generan un impacto positivo en la sociedad. Nuestra plantilla, formada por más de 65.000 profesionales y presente en más de 40 países de los cinco continentes, contribuye a nuestra misión de diseñar un planeta mejor. Buscamos personas que quieran marcar la diferencia, promover el desarrollo sostenible y encontrar soluciones a los mayores desafíos globales, incluidos el cambio climático, la sobrepoblación y la escasez hídrica. Únete a nosotros en la búsqueda de soluciones para lograr un futuro sostenible.   Responsabilidades   Liderar la relación con clientes potenciales públicos asignados (identificación de contacto, presentación de servicios, prospección, seguimiento del proceso oferta, etc), alineado con la Estrategia del Plan Comercial.  Monitorizar licitaciones públicas.  Registro de las acciones comerciales (contactos, tareas, oportunidades, ofertas, etc) en el CRM.  Gestionar la asistencia y participación en actividades de networking (entidades colaboradoras, ferias, eventos).  Búsqueda de posibles socios para alianzas (acuerdos, UTE, etc.) en la zona para participar en proyectos no asumibles de forma unilateral.  Liderar las reuniones de inicio de servicio.  Coordinar la propuesta, revisión, negociación y firma de los contratos posteriores a la adjudicación de los servicios y anteriores a los inicios de los mismos.  Difundir internamente las novedades respecto a estado de competidores, nuevas oportunidades de tipologías de actividades a realizar, etc y en general, todo lo relativo al avance del mercado potencial de contratos.  Obtener información (palancas) de las oportunidades de negocio en base a la cual el cliente decidirá futuras adjudicaciones (estado del servicio y del competidor, expectativas y requisitos de los clientes potenciales, etc).  Definir y revisar la oferta a presentar a los clientes públicos, coordinándose con el Técnico de Ofertas que corresponda.  Identificar nuevas posibles colaboraciones, eventos y opciones de patrocinio en los que participar para difundir la imagen de marca.    Misión  Ejecutar las partes del proyecto asignadas dentro de su unidad/departamento, de acuerdo a procedimientos establecidos, a fin de facilitar el cumplimiento de los plazos establecidos y coordinar los recursos necesarios (humanos y materiales), impulsando la aportación de mejoras significativas al proyecto.  Son responsables de identificar problemas estratégicos internos y externos que pueden afectar al crecimiento y a la rentabilidad de la organización. Las actividades incluyen: identificar oportunidades de crecimiento, innovación del modelo de negocio, y facilitar iniciativas transversales entre unidades de negocio; seguimiento de tendencias del mercado a medio/largo plazo, recopilación de datos de la competencia para contribuir a las discusiones estratégicas de planificación comercial; identificar y desarrollar modelos de ingresos óptimos (revenue management), canales de distribución, precios, y estrategias de desarrollo de nuevos productos; identificar y negociar partnerships estratégicos incluyendo acuerdos financieros, intercambio de clientes, y derechos de propiedad intelectual; priorizar y rastrear inversiones a través de nuevas iniciativas de desarrollo de productos, y todo ello soportado con un análisis exhaustivo de la información para poder tomar las mejores decisiones posibles.  Requisitos del candidato   Titulación superior.  Amplia experiencia, al menos 5 años, captando y gestionando desarrollo de negocio en clientes, preferentemente en el Sector Público, Empresas Estatales, etc.  Conocimiento del sector servicios, y en concreto Facility Services, también valorable servicios comerciales, servicios de selección, servicios de ETT.  Conocimiento o buen manejo de los procedimientos de Contratación Pública, plataformas de contratación, etc.  Perfil con fluidez y soltura en la comunicación con diferentes interlocutores (nivel sindical, funcionarios, personal operativo).  Buenas habilidades relacionales, comunicativas, y clara orientación a objetivos.  Inglés avanzado.    Somos una compañía que valora la diversidad como fuente de talento y por ello trabajamos para impulsar un entorno inclusivo en el que se promueve el respeto, la pertenencia y el compromiso de forma que todas las personas puedan participar en igualdad de oportunidades. Invitamos a todas las personas a inscribirse con independencia del origen, circunstancias, bagaje o condición. ACCIONA ha recibido la certificación Top Employer 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 y 2025, que reconoce a la Compañía como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar en España.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Technical Solutions Engineer - Platform
description:

This role is hybrid with 3 days in our São Paulo office.  As a Sr. Technical Solutions Engineer, you will provide technical support for Databricks Platform related issues and resolve any challenges involving the Databricks unified analytics platform. You will assist customers in their Databricks journey and provide them with the guidance and knowledge that they need to accomplish value and achieve their strategic goals using our products. They will look to you for answers to everything from basic technical questions to complex architectural scenarios spanning across the entire Big Data ecosystem. You will report to the Senior Manager of Technical Solutions. Expert level knowledge in python is desired.  Solid experience with SQL-based database is required.  Linux/Unix administration skills.  Hands‑on experience with AWS, Azure or GCP.  Candidate must possess excellent English written and oral communication skills.  Experience with "Distributed Big Data Computing" environment.  Technical degree or the equivalent experience. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow. To learn more, follow Databricks on Twitter, LinkedIn and Facebook.  Benefits  At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. title: Financial Business Analyst / Quality Assurance (Brazil)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Financial Business Analyst / Quality Assurance (Brazil) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Introduction  Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.  Overview  Gallagher is a global leader in insurance, risk management and consulting services. We help businesses grow, communities thrive and people prosper. We live a culture defined by The Gallagher Way, our set of shared values and guiding tenets. A culture driven by our people, over 50,000 strong, serving our clients with customized solutions that will protect them and fuel their futures.  We are seeking a senior Business Analyst / Quality Assurance Analyst to play a pivotal role in the Global System Implementation program in Brazil, deploying JDE (ERP/GL/AP/PO/FA), Kyriba (Treasury), Circulus (AP Automation) and Concur (T&E).  This role will work closely with global teams, local stakeholders, and the external implementation vendor to ensure that local requirements and regulatory needs are accurately captured, designed, tested, and delivered in alignment with the global template and program standards.  The person in this role will act as the main link between Brazil’s business and finance teams and the vendor, making sure local needs are clearly understood and correctly implemented. Strong knowledge of Accounting and Finance, experience with financial system implementations, and solid QA skills are essential.  How you'll make an impact   Solution Design   Lead, collect and document business requirements with Accounting (General Ledger, Chart of Accounts), Finance, Fixed Assets, Accounts Receivable, Trade and Non-Trade Accounts Payable, Procurement, Treasury Management (Kyriba), Tax, Master Data, Travel & Expense (Concur), Operations, and other business areas. Translate needs into clear business requirements, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.  Support solution design sessions with the vendor and global teams.  Perform fit-gap analysis against the global template (JDE, Kyriba, Circulus, Concur), proposing viable localization designs for Brazil.  Create process maps (as-is / to-be) and help define internal controls.  Support data related activities such as mapping, validation, and master data definitions.      Quality Assurance & Testing Leadership   Create and maintain the testing plan including functional, integration, regression, and UAT.  Write or review test cases and ensure all requirements have clear acceptance criteria.  Track and manage defects, helping teams resolve issues quickly.  Organize and support User Acceptance Testing with business users.  Document test results and prepare materials for go live readiness.      Change Management, Training & Adoption   Support change impact assessments, stakeholder communications, and training (materials, playbooks).  Prepare training materials and help run training sessions when needed.  Work with teams to ensure successful adoption of the new tools and processes.      Brazil Localization, Controls & Compliance   Ensure system design meets Brazilian accounting, tax and regulatory requirements (e.g., SPED ECD/ECF, withholding taxes, ICMS / ISS / IOF / PIS / COFINS, CNAB banking files), aligning with global accounting policies (IFRS/US GAAP) and internal control frameworks (SOX, Segregation of Duties).  Review impacts on financial close, reconciliations, tax calculations and audit requirements.  Validate rules related to taxes, reporting, electronic documents, and other local obligations.      Data, Integration & Banking Connectivity   Work with the vendor and IT teams to define and validate integration interfaces across systems (JDE, Kyriba, Circulus, Concur, Tax/Invoice Vendor, Payroll).  Support data migration activities, including data preparation, testing and reconciliation.  Assist in designing and validating bank connections, payment files and statement imports.  Support environment setup and infrastructure configuration, including validation of system environments, connectivity and technical readiness.  Test and validate user access, roles and permissions across JDE, Kyriba, Circulus, Concur and integrated systems.  Coordinate and test connectivity and integration flows with the Corporate JDE environment and other global platforms.  Work with IT teams to troubleshoot environment issues, interface failures, access problems and technical dependencies.      Vendor & Stakeholder Management   Work closely with the implementation partner, reviewing deliverables and tracking progress.  Monitor open issues, follow up on deadlines and help manage scope changes.  Ensure the vendor understands local needs and delivers solutions that work for Brazil.  Communicate risks and problems early to avoid delays.  Align global, regional (LatAm) and local stakeholders through clear status reporting, demos and decision logs.      Delivery Methodology & Governance   Work within Agile/Hybrid delivery (backlog management, sprint planning, demos/retros, release readiness).  Maintain rigorous project documentation (requirements, configurations, test evidence, SOPs), ensuring auditability and knowledge transfer.  Support cutover planning, go live preparation and hypercare after deployment.        About you   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field.  8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or QA Analyst.  Solid grounding in Accounting/Finance processes (period close, accruals, reconciliations, AP/AR, T&E), with understanding of IFRS/US GAAP; Brazil statutory/tax familiarity is essential.  Proven experience implementing systems such as JDE, Kyriba, Concur or AP automation tools.  Experience with integrations, data migration and banking processes.  Understanding of Brazilian tax and accounting rules is required.  Experience in insurance/brokerage accounting and operations is a strong plus.  Knowledge of Agile / Hybrid methods and tools (Azure DevOps, etc.).  Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  Ability to work with global teams in different time zones.  Languages: English – mandatory; Portuguese – mandatory; Spanish – fluent is a strong advantage.  Willingness to travel occasionally (US and Latin American region).  Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid).     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Aqui você pode se cadastrar para participar dos processos seletivos.  E isso só é possível graças à dedicação de nossos colaboradores, chamados carinhosamente de "moppeanos", que têm uma paixão genuína por educação. É assim desde o início. Fomos criados em 1982, a partir de um sonho da Teresinha, nossa diretora. Ela tinha o desejo de construir uma escola diferente de tudo o que se praticava na época, uma escola que formasse alunos muito além do conteúdo e isso só foi possível com o encontro de outras pessoas que compartilhavam deste mesmo ideal. Aqui na Moppe você vai encontrar um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico, afetivo, com uma história e missão valorosa. E saiba que aqui o foco está na parceria, pois independente da área de atuação na escola, buscamos pessoas criativas e movidas pela paixão em aprender, construir e melhorar continuamente aquilo pelo que forem responsáveis.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Public Safety Relations Senior Manager  Job Locations  BR-SP-Sao Paulo  ID     Company Overview  If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.  We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).  To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.  Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.  #LI-Hybrid  Team Overview  We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Public Safety Relations Senior Manager for Brazil, who will oversee the operational engagement with public safety, law enforcement agencies and judicial authorities, serving as an expert partner to the Government Affairs, Security, Legal, Compliance, Online Safety, and Operations teams within the ride-hailing and delivery business.  This crucial position is dedicated to strengthening Didi's Public Safety partnerships, initiatives, and projects across Brazil, while employing technology-driven strategies to ensure strict adherence to data protection, privacy, and regulatory compliance standards.  Role Responsibilities   Implement and support operational processes for Public Safety engagement, ensuring alignment with business objectives related to ride hailing and delivery safety.  Serve as Didi´s Public Safety subject matter expert for public sector stakeholders, advocating for technology-based solutions within the ride-hailing and food delivery sectors.  Maintain and apply operational models and KPIs for law enforcement engagement, incorporating industry best practices to enhance service delivery.  Serve as a primary contact for sensitive investigations, government requests, and high-impact incidents, offering expert operational support to facilitate timely resolution.  Support the deployment and continuous improvement of law enforcement engagement platforms (e.g., LERT), emphasizing efficiency, traceability, and regulatory compliance.  Facilitate technology-enabled cooperation through frameworks, institutional agreements, and training programs that enhance interactions with law enforcement and judicial partners.  Collaborate with Legal and Compliance teams to assess and mitigate legal, regulatory, and reputational risks related to public safety and law enforcement interactions, particularly in the context of rides and deliveries.  Monitor and analyze public safety and law enforcement trends affecting the ride-hailing and food delivery sectors, focusing on privacy, data access, and public safety.  Work cross-functionally with global and regional teams, including Government Affairs, Legal, Security, Public Policy, Privacy, Online Safety, Engineering to support comprehensive public safety partnerships and initiatives.  Prepare and deliver operational reports and insights to local leadership, highlighting key developments and areas for improvement.  Uphold the highest standards of ethics, confidentiality, and data protection in all engagements with law enforcement and judicial authorities.    Role Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Law, Criminal Justice, Public Policy, Security, or a related field; advanced degree strongly preferred.  10+ years of experience in law enforcement, judicial systems or in senior-level law enforcement roles, or executive-level outreach roles within technology or multinational organizations.  Proven experience managing senior-level government and law enforcement relationships in complex regulatory environments.  Strong understanding of the Brazilian legal, regulatory, and law enforcement landscape, particularly as it applies to digital platforms and data governance.  Exceptional stakeholder management, negotiation, and influence skills.  Experience handling sensitive, high-risk, and high-visibility matters with sound judgment and discretion.  Fluency in English at an executive/corporate level; Spanish proficiency is a strong plus.  Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.  Executive presence and high-impact communication.  Data-driven decision-making and operational excellence.  Cross-functional communication.  High ethical standards and strong compliance mindset.    EEO Statement  We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).  Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today. We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys. This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.  We acknowledge and support that this position is open to all qualified applicants. Build, adapt, and iterate visual assets quickly, turning direction into concrete creative outputs.  Prototype new creative approaches and variations to support ongoing campaigns.  Work closely with Product Marketing Managers (PMMs) and Creative Producers to align on needs, timing, and execution.  Make fast creative decisions to keep production moving as priorities shift.  Reuse, combine, and adapt existing assets to maximize speed and output.  Apply learnings from past campaigns and market references to inform creative execution.  Use available tools, including AI, to streamline production and scale creative delivery.  Maintain a strong standard of craft while working under tight timelines.    What You’ll Need   Practical knowledge of Adobe After Effects for basic to intermediate motion work and adaptations.  Basic knowledge of video editing fundamentals, including timing, pacing, and visual clarity.  Basic knowledge of image editing and asset preparation using tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar.  Ability to work with existing assets, templates, and references to produce multiple creative variations.  Strong interest and hands‑on experience using AI tools available in the market to produce visual assets and accelerate creative production.  Strong comfort working with short turnaround times and frequently shifting priorities.  Familiarity with creative production workflows for performance marketing campaigns.  Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn, test, and adopt new tools, workflows, and AI solutions as they emerge.  Ability to make quick execution decisions and move work forward independently.  Clear communication skills and experience collaborating with PMMs, Creative Producers, and other creative partners.    More About You   You enjoy making things and feel comfortable working hands‑on with visual assets every day.  You’re a versatile creative who can adapt quickly and keep production moving as priorities change.  You’re curious by nature and actively explore new tools, especially AI, to improve how you work and what you deliver.  You value speed and momentum, but still care about quality and clarity in your outputs.  You’re comfortable working with direction rather than detailed prescriptions, and can turn guidance into finished creatives.  You take ownership of your work, manage your time well, and follow through on deliveries.  You collaborate effectively with people from different backgrounds and levels of seniority, including senior stakeholders, keeping communication clear and practical.  You thrive in fast‑paced environments and stay calm when deadlines are tight.    About Wildlife  Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Finland and the United States. title: Inside Sales Representative, Tensec Brasil
description:

Inside Sales Representative (São Paulo)  About Tensec  Founded in 2023 Tensec is a fast-growing global fintech start up revolutionizing how businesses move money across borders. Our digital solutions simplify FX transactions  enable seamless access to US-based bank accounts  and provide innovative tools for managing international financial operations. Tensec founders have driven startups from foundation to exit built decacorns and led global teams at companies such as PayPal Credit Karma Facebook Goldman Sachs Visa Mastercard and American Express. Were well on our way putting together a world-class team to disrupt the $50 trillion cross-border b2b financial services industry by providing SMBs the financial strength to participate and win in the global economy. We believe that successful companies and teams are directly correlated to a companys cultural DNA. At Tensec we make a deliberate effort to create values and foster a culture able to unleash both human and organizational potential. We strongly believe that the best business results derive from teams that have a strong identification with a mission push themselves to the edge and love what they do. The Tensec team is diverse and global with members in New York Palo Alto São Paulo and Mexico City. We are funded by top venture capital firms such as Costanoa Ventures Montage Ventures Quiet Capital Ignia Partners Endeavor and Cambrian Ventures. About the role:  We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Inside Sales Representative  to join our growing team in São Paulo . This role will focus on prospecting engaging and closing new clients  and its primary responsibility will be to identify potential customers demonstrate the value of our cross-border payment and banking solutions and convert prospects into long-term clients. You must be passionate about sales eager to learn and attentive to details. You must also be able to develop a deep understanding of Tensecs products and solutions and the industry to be able to match our offering with the right customer and suggest new product features to enable the long term success and growth of our customers and open new business opportunities for Tensec. Location: São Paulo  Positions in our hubs are hybrid and include core working days of Tuesday Wednesday and Thursday in the office. We provide flexible work options based on distance from our hubs. Tensec believes in the power of face-to-face personal connection. As a result we prioritize in-person candidates. Key Responsibilities: Lead Generation and Prospecting  Identify and research potential customers in key industries and markets.   Qualify inbound leads and generate outbound leads through cold calls emails and social media outreach.   Build a pipeline of prospective customers by leveraging CRM tools industry databases and market insights.    Sales Outreach  Initiate and develop relationships with decision-makers at FX correspondents and other businesses who need cross-border financial solutions.   Conduct effective discovery calls to understand clients pain points and financial needs.    Product Presentation  Deliver compelling presentations and demonstrations of our digital solutions including FX transactions cross-border payments and US bank accounts.   Clearly articulate the value proposition and tailor it to specific client use cases.    Closing Deals  Build and maintain strong long-lasting client relationships to encourage repeat business.   Negotiate terms manage objections and finalize agreements to achieve sales targets.   Ensure seamless onboarding of new clients coordinating with internal teams as needed.    Client Relationship Management  Own and drive the countrys P&L ensuring sustainable growth profitability and cost efficiency.   Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services.    Collaboration and Reporting  Monitor progress towards meeting sales goals and report results to management.   Collaborate with the operations to onboard the customer on the Tensec platform in compliance with all local and global compliance requirements.   Collaborate with marketing product and customer success teams to align efforts and share insights.   Proactively suggest product improvements to the Product team to build the sales pipeline and enhance cross-sell opportunities.   Maintain accurate records of all sales activities and pipeline progress in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.   Collaborate with other members of the sales team to develop strategies to achieve sales goals.   Stay up to date on market and industry trends competition and customer needs and provide feedback to other team members to support company growth and product development.     Required Qualifications:  Bachelors degree in business or a related field.  Experience in B2B sales or business development.  Familiarity with CRM tools like HubSpot Salesforce or similar platforms.  Knowledge of sales techniques and strategies and experience with outbound prospecting tools and techniques.  Excellent communication negotiation interpersonal and relationship-building abilities with the ability to build rapport and influence decision-makers.  Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  Customer-focused with a commitment to providing high-quality service.  You will stand out if:  Knowledge of the Brazilian financial ecosystem and regulations and a strong understanding of cross-border financial services FX transactions and/or digital banking solutions.  English and Spanish proficiency (both verbal and written).  Experience selling financial products and services.  In-office presence in São Paulo City Faria Lima neighborhood.   Personal Traits:  Goal-oriented self-motivated and able to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.  Flexible and adaptable to change.  Exceptional problem-solving skills and a customer-centric mindset.  Excellent time management skills.   Benefits:  Competitive base salary with an uncapped commission structure tied to role may require occasional travel between the US and Mexico.  Stock options: youll have a stake in our future success.  Medical dental VR VA plans and life insurance.  Gympass  Opportunity to work with an innovative globally-focused fintech team.  Professional growth in a high-impact role with plenty of autonomy and support.  Tensec is a developmental organization. We are organized around the simple but radical conviction that we will best prosper as a company when we are collectively aligned with our peoples professional growth and we weave our peoples development into the daily fabric of our operations. We will invest and expect you to dedicate time to coach mentor and be mentored and to technical subjects and courses of use to your professional growth.  Stipend to use towards your personal professional development.  Team meetups and events.   Tensec is a diverse and inclusive company committed to growing a diverse and inclusive team. title: Bandidos atiram e roubam carro na área externa do Shopping Catuaí
description:
Empresa está contratando Bandidos atiram e roubam carro na área externa do Shopping Catuaí em maringá. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Um pai que segurava seu filho de 3 anos no colo foi vítima de um assalto do lado de fora do Shopping Catuaí, em Maringá. Dois criminosos abordaram a vítima quando ela desembarcava de um automóvel Peugeot. O condutor que estava indo ao shopping Catuaí teve uma arma de fogo apontada em sua cabeça. Mesmo com o filho no colo, os ladrões não tiveram nenhum tipo de remorso. Um dos suspeitos pediu a chave do carro e o celular. O outro comparsa fogiu em um carro de cor vermelha. O meliante que estava armado atirou para o alto duas vezes para amedrontar a vítima. O automóvel foi abandonado minutos depois na Vila Guadiana, em Mandaguaçu. A Polícia Civil de Maringá já está investigando o roubo. Investigadores já receberam denúncias de possíveis suspeitos que participaram do crime. (inf André Almenara)  #J-18808-Ljbffr

With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa. title: CRM Manager (Braze Expert)
description:
Nova oportunidade para CRM Manager (Braze Expert) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Overview  As CRM Manager (Customer Relationship Management), you will play a critical role in leading the delivery of our CRM program across the Americas/EMEA/LAC/APAC region while driving major strategic initiatives on a global scale. You will collaborate with stakeholders worldwide to scale and enhance our CRM capabilities and provide direct line management to team members as required. In this role, you will take full ownership of the Americas CRM landscape and agenda, working closely with a global, cross-functional team to drive day-to-day CRM planning, management, and execution across the region. The primary focus will be to deliver sustainable growth through ongoing tactical and strategic campaign optimization, supported by regular performance analysis and clear communication of insights back to the business.  Essential Duties and Responsibilities   CRM Program Management: CRM Leadership & Ownership Responsible for owning and delivering best-in-class CRM strategy and execution across the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, using Braze as a core platform to drive personalised, timely, and high-performing customer communications. You will play a key role in advancing CRM capability, embedding innovation, and delivering measurable commercial and customer outcomes.  Own and lead the end-to-end delivery and performance of the CRM program across the Americas/EMEA/LAC/APAC region.  Set the strategic direction for the Americas/EMEA/LAC/APAC CRM agenda, driving efficient day-to-day planning, management, and execution.  Translate business objectives and customer insights into clear CRM plans and roadmaps.  Champion a customer-first, value-led approach to CRM, aligned with best practice  Serve as the primary regional authority and escalation point for all CRM-related activity.  Lead the scoping, planning, and execution of major data, technology, and marketing automation initiatives to advance CRM capability and impact.  Own CRM performance analysis and reporting across the region, delivering clear, actionable insights and recommendations to inform strategy, optimization, and business decision-making. CRM Expertise  Act as a Braze subject-matter expert, owning campaign builds, Canvas journeys, segmentation, and orchestration.  Design and deliver multi-channel CRM activity leveraging Braze capabilities such as real-time event triggers, dynamic content, and connected content to drive relevance and performance.  Partner with technical teams to optimise data feeds, integrations, and event schemas.  Drive advanced personalisation using behavioural, transactional, and preference data.  Apply modern CRM techniques such as: Real-time and event-based messaging & AI-driven send-time optimisation and message prioritisation and  Decisioning and next-best-action logic  Proactively stay ahead of CRM innovation, identifying and piloting new features and emerging industry capabilities.  Own the CRM testing and optimisation framework, including A/B testing, multivariate testing.  Use performance data and insights to continuously optimise journeys, content, and cadence.  Measure incrementality and ROI to demonstrate CRM impact on commercial outcomes.  Monitor and report on CRM performance against KPIs, including engagement, conversion, retention, and revenue.  Partner with analytics teams to define success metrics and improve reporting maturity. Translate data into actionable insights and recommendations for stakeholders.  Team and Stakeholder Collaboration  Provide leadership and management to CRM team members, as relevant, ensuring effective delivery of the agreed CRM strategy while prioritizing capability building, performance, and long-term professional development.  Act as the regional authority and subject-matter expert for all CRM-related initiatives, providing strategic guidance, best practices, and thought leadership across the organization.  Foster strong collaboration with internal stakeholders and cross-functional partners to ensure CRM initiatives are aligned with broader business and marketing objectives.  Serve as the primary point of contact for our email service provider, managing the relationship to ensure strong performance, operational excellence, and ongoing platform optimization.  Partner closely with external vendors and technology partners as required to support CRM execution, innovation, and continuous improvement.    Location: Based in any Americas’ office (100% on site/hybrid)  Behavioral Expectations  As CRM Manager, you will be expected to role model the behaviors aligned with our Ten Standards and our core values of being Member Focused, Trustworthy, and Pioneering. This requires a consistently positive, solution-oriented, and collaborative approach to your work. You will demonstrate a strong customer-centric mindset, advanced analytical capability, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently. A proactive approach to problem-solving, coupled with a commitment to continuous improvement, will be critical to driving the ongoing success and evolution of our CRM initiatives. We encourage diverse philosophies, cultures and experiences. We appreciate diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for our employees. This idea unites the teams at TEN. All aspects of our relationship, including the decision to hire, promote, discipline or terminate, will be based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.   Significant experience as a CRM Manager with a deep understanding of core CRM principles.  Proven line management experience is essential.  Extensive experience with Email Service Providers (ESPs), including creating and reviewing complex segmentation queries.  Minimum 2 years of experience with Braze  Strong customer-centric mindset, covering campaign creation, lifecycle optimization, test & learn methodology, KPI definition, and reporting.  Excellent data and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret insights and provide actionable recommendations.  Proven track record in managing end-to-end CRM programs and email marketing processes.  Expertise in CRM principles, email marketing, and customer lifecycle management.  Demonstrated ability to drive measurable improvements in campaign effectiveness and KPIs.  Ability to define, implement, and promote best practices in CRM and email marketing.  Strong project management, communication, and analytical skills.  Experience collaborating with global stakeholders and managing relationships with email service providers.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).    Benefits  Aside from regular Extended Health, Dental, Vision, we have other benefits listed below:   Employee Assistance and mental wellness resources  Travel offers from a variety of sources that allow great discounts on hotels, cruises, and rental cars. These vary by location.  3 extra float days after 3 years of work.  One month off, fully paid sabbatical every 5 years of work, in addition to your Paid Time Off days.  Full catalogue of learning modules that cover a wide range of categories for personal and professional development  Discount on Pet Insurance and a variety of other non-travel perks and discounts  Working Holidays: Ability to work from any of our 23 global offices for a short period of time    DE & I Statement  Widespread acceptance for every person. We encourage diverse philosophies, cultures, and backgrounds. We praise diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for our employees. This idea ties the Ten teams together. Ten is honored to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Product Manager: Payments Mandates & Regulatory Readiness
description:
Confira a vaga para Product Manager: Payments Mandates & Regulatory Readiness em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Product Manager: Payments Mandates & Regulatory Readiness At EBANX , we believe barriers were made to be broken. We started our story in Curitiba, Brazil, and today we are a global company present in more than 29 countries, with offices in Curitiba, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Johannesburg . In total, we are 700+ ebankers  spread across the world, connecting companies like Uber, Netflix, Spotify, TikTok, Canva, Shopee, Meta, and Shein  to millions of consumers in emerging markets—creating new opportunities and revolutionizing the future of digital payments. Our mission is clear: to give global access to everyone . We are guided by the motto #TamoJunto , which translates into four key pillars: Shape Tomorrow, Evolve Fast, Make It Happen, and Unlock The World.  If you want to be part of a global company with accelerated growth that is shaping the future of digital payments, EBANX is the place for you. At EBANX’s Product team you don’t just create features. You develop user-centered solutions that transform the experience of millions of consumers and global companies. Every product decision you make has a real impact on the future of digital payments, combining strategic vision, innovation, and collaboration to make our work truly Out Of The Ordinary . As a Product Manager for Payments Mandates & Regulatory Readiness, your mission will be to build and lead EBANX’s strategy for scheme and regulatory compliance. You will be responsible for creating a unified product-owned governance model that ensures readiness, visibility, and proactive execution of all Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and regulatory requirements that impact our payments capabilities. You will sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and our global merchant base, playing a critical part in enabling EBANX to scale safely, maintain performance, unlock new features, and operate with predictability in fast-evolving markets. Define the vision, framework, and processes for mandates and regulatory readiness across all markets; Build a centralized governance model that brings structure, visibility, and ownership to scheme and regulatory requirements; Partner cross-functionally with engineering, compliance, legal, ops, and country teams to assess impact, scope solutions, and ensure on-time delivery; Track the evolving landscape of scheme mandates, regulatory changes, and technical requirements, anticipating their implications for EBANX; Prioritize mandates and compliance initiatives based on risk, business impact, and market strategy; Manage the full lifecycle of each mandate, from understanding requirements, to defining product impact, to coordinating implementation and ensuring readiness ahead of deadlines; Guarantee clear communication, documentation, and alignment across teams, enabling predictable execution and reducing operational risk; Act as the internal expert on scheme and regulatory evolution, supporting strategic decisions and shaping future product capabilities.  Must-haves to shine in this role:  Proven experience in product management, payments, regulatory compliance, or fintech infrastructure; Strong understanding of the global payment ecosystem, scheme rules (Visa/Mastercard/Amex), and regulatory frameworks; Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex regulatory or scheme requirements and translate them into product impact; Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing cross-functional teams and senior leadership; Experience working in agile environments and leading multi-team initiatives under tight deadlines; Demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguity, build processes from scratch, and drive predictable execution in complex contexts.  Bonus points if you have:  Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth companies or global fintechs; Multicultural experience collaborating across countries and teams; A passion for simplifying complexity, building governance models, and creating long-term strategic foundations; Knowledge of scheme mandates, regulatory landscapes, or compliance-related product work; A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to anticipate risks and connect details to strategic outcomes.  EBANX offers:  Performance Bonus:  Annual bonus program based on company results. EBANX Education:  Financial assistance for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs to support your professional growth. EBANX Skills:  Dedicated budget for courses, certifications, and workshops to encourage continuous learning. Language Classes:  Language classes to support your personal and professional development. Health & Well-being:  Medical and dental plans with extensive coverage, including support for dependents and wellness programs. Flexible Work Culture:  Semi-flexible hours, additional day off on your birthday, and year-end break to support work-life balance. Well-being Program:  Access to activities and resources that promote physical and mental health.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Suporte na diagramação e atualização de materiais institucionais.  Apoio na organização de pautas e alinhamento com diferentes áreas para garantir a fluidez da comunicação interna.  Revisão e tradução de comunicados e materiais enviados pela equipe global, garantindo adaptação ao contexto local.    Eventos   Suporte na organização de eventos internos e externos, incluindo contato com fornecedores e logística básica.  Auxílio na produção e controle de materiais de divulgação e brindes institucionais.  Apoio na comunicação pré e pós‑evento, incluindo convites, comunicados e cobertura.    Materiais Institucionais   Suporte na atualização e organização de materiais gráficos e digitais, como folders, apresentações e brindes institucionais. Observações: Inglês – avançado ou no mínimo intermediário.    Competências importantes   Organização – Para gerenciar tarefas simultâneas, manter materiais atualizados e auxiliar na execução de eventos e comunicados internos.  Comunicação – Essencial para redigir e revisar conteúdos, traduzir materiais globais e interagir com diferentes áreas da empresa.  Lidar com múltiplas demandas – Capacidade de priorizar atividades e adaptar‑se a diferentes necessidades da equipe de Marketing & Comunicação.    Pontos que não dariam certo   Desorganização – Pode impactar o gerenciamento de tarefas, o cumprimento de prazos e a qualidade das entregas.  Falta de atenção a detalhes – Pode comprometer a revisão de comunicados, traduções e a precisão das informações.
